note: Camden County's zoning districts (Zoning layer 36, Camdenton Zoning, Sunrise Beach Zoning, and Four Seasons Zoning) are served from integritygis ArcGIS services (services8 Camden_Assessor_Data and services5 Four_Seasons_Zoning) that return 'Token Required' to anonymous requests. The county's public zoning resource is a static PDF map (PZ_Districts.pdf). No open zoning service was found; Lake Ozark zoning is a map package only. Not worked around the token requirement.
